title: Construction of CRISPR Plasmids and Detection of Knockout Efficiency in Mammalian Cells through a Dual Luciferase Reporter System
protocol: Design sgRNAs using online tools such as the Cas-Designer online tool.
Consider NG PAM sequences for xCas9 when designing sgRNAs.
Use sgRNA design tools that include algorithms for on-target and off-target prediction.
Select up to 3 gene editing targets for an optimum screening.
Delete the 3’-NG protospacer adjacent motif (PAM) from the sgRNA oligonucleotide sequence.
Keep the protospacer sequence intact after deleting the PAM.
Add the pentanucleotide CACCG to the 5’-end of the oligo.
Create a reverse complement of the protospacer sequence.
Append AAAC to the 5’-end of the rc protospacer sequence.
Append an additional C to the 3’-end of the rc protospacer.
Order the oligonucleotides.
Dilute lyophilized oligonucleotides to a final concentration of 10 μM in double distilled water (ddH2O).
Mix forward and reverse oligonucleotides in a thin wall PCR tube maintaining a 1:1 ratio.
Incubate the mixture at 95 °C for 5 min.
Ramp down the temperature to 72 °C for 10 min.
Cool the sample by removing it from the PCR machine and placing it at room temperature (RT).
Digest 1 μg of the selected pX330-xCas9 vector with BbsI (10 units of enzyme per 1 μg of plasmid) for 2 h at 37 °C.
Purify the digested vector by band extraction from a 2% agarose gel under 10 V/cm.
Subsequently purify using a silica column using a commercial gel extraction kit.
Mix annealed sgRNA oligonucleotides (5 μL of the mixture) with BbsI-digested pX330-xCas9 vector (purified, 100 ng).
Add 1 μL of ligase and 1 μL of 10x ligase buffer.
Incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Take out E. coli DH5α competent cells from storage at -80 °C and thaw it on ice.
Add 5 μL of the ligation mix to 50 μL of competent E. coli DH5α and keep the mixture on ice for 30 min.
Heat shock the mixture at 42 °C for 90 s.
Rest the mixture on ice for 2 min.
Recover the culture in a rotary shaker in 500 μL of LB media for 1 h at 37 °C.
Plate 200 μL of the culture on an ampicillin resistance LB agarose plate and incubate it overnight at 37 °C.
Choose 5 to 10 bacterial colonies from the LB plate and use each colony to inoculate one 1.5 mL tube containing 1 mL of LB media with 60 mg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the tubes on a rotary shaker for 2-3 h.
Prepare the PCR mixture according to Table 2.
Perform pre-denaturation at 95 °C for 5 min.
Denature at 95 °C for 30 s, anneal at 60 °C for 30 s, and extend at 72 °C for 30 s for 30 cycles.
Complete the PCR with a final extension step by heating at 72 °C for 5 min.
Run the PCR product on a 2% agarose gel under 10 V/cm.
Identify a band at the expected size [e.g., 287 bp] as positive.
Validate the sequence of sgRNA expression plasmid by Sanger sequencing using the reverse primer BbsI-R.
Sequence positive colonies using the forward primer T1-F to confirm the presence of the xCas9 expressing sgRNA sequence.
Synthesize 300-500 bp DNA fragments containing the sgRNA targets from genomic sequences.
Subclone the synthesized DNA fragments into a dual luciferase reporter vector through double digestion with AscI and SalI.
Select a suitable dual luciferase reporter vector, such as pSSA-Dual16,17 or two vectors expressing firefly luciferase and renilla luciferase respectively.
Ligate two fragments with T4 DNA Ligase to form pSSA-Dual-Target.
Amplify the reporter vector in stable bacteria strains like Top10.
Culture bacteria at a rotational speed no higher than 200 rpm.
Extract endotoxin-free plasmids for vectors as stated.
Evaluate the purity and concentration of plasmids using suitable instruments.
Ensure a final concentration of at least 500 ng/μL for plasmids.
Maintain a purity ratio between 1.7-1.9 at absorbance 260/280 nm (A260/A280).
Co-transfect an appropriate cell line such as PIEC with the plasmids in equal proportion.
Use pX330-xCas9-xDKK2 and pSSA-Dual-DKK2 plasmids at a ratio of 1:1 for transfection.
Employ pX330-xCas9 as a negative control during transfection.
One day before the transfection, plate cells in a 24-well culture plate at a density of 2 x 10^5 cells/well.
Wait until cells achieve confluence between 60-80% for transfection readiness.
Remove supernatant as much as possible from each well.
Gently add 0.5 mL of fresh media to each well before transfection.
Dilute transfection reagent in DMEM media at a ratio of 1:25.
Mix the diluted transfection reagent thoroughly.
Dilute 0.5 μg of DNA in 25 μL of DMEM media.
Add 1 μL of P3000 reagent to the diluted DNA.
Mix diluted DNA with each tube of diluted transfection reagent (1:1 ratio).
Incubate the mixture for 10–15 min at room temperature.
Add 50 μL of DNA-lipid complex to cells.
Incubate cells for 24 h at 37 °C.
Prepare a sufficient quantity of the 1x passive lysis buffer (PLB) by adding 1 volume of 5x PLB to 4 volumes of distilled water and mix well.
Remove the growth medium from the cultured cells.
Gently apply a sufficient volume of phosphate buffered saline (PBS) to wash the surface of the culture vessel.
Swirl the vessel briefly to remove detached cells and residual growth medium.
Completely remove the rinse solution before applying PLB reagent.
Dispense 100 μL of 1x PLB into each culture well to completely cover the cell monolayer.
Let the culture plates stand for 20 min.
Transfer the lysate to a tube or vial for further handling or storage.
Prepare luciferase assay reagent (LAR) by resuspending the provided lyophilized luciferase assay substrate in 10 mL of the supplied luciferase assay buffer.
Prepare an adequate volume of LAR to perform the desired number of dual-luciferase reporter assays (100 µL reagent per assay).
Add 1 volume of 50x stop substrate to 50 volumes of stop buffer in a glass or siliconized polypropylene tube.
Program luminometers to provide a 2-second pre-read delay followed by a 10-second measurement period.
Predispense 100 µL of luciferase assay reagent into luminometer tubes.
Transfer up to 20 µL of cell lysate into the luminometer tube containing LAR.
Mix the sample by pipetting 2 or 3 times.
Place the tube in the luminometer and initiate reading.
Remove the sample tube from the luminometer and add 100 µL of stop reagent.
Vortex briefly to mix.
Replace the sample in the luminometer and initiate reading.
Record renilla luciferase activity normalized to firefly luciferase activity.
Discard the reaction tube.
Proceed to the next assay.
